Both proclamations use section 22 machinery in the same sequence: Tariff Commission investigation and report; a presidential finding that specified agricultural imports are practically certain to interfere with Department of Agriculture programs; a necessity finding; and operative import fees applied to articles entered or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption. The child expands this established structure from almonds to several dairy and agricultural products and adds quotas and licensing. C06 is a closely related earlier version of the same fee machinery, while C05 supplies related section 22 quota-and-license administration but is less structurally
